items.root_cause: the aisle gate's authored category->department map cannot express where Family Fare actually shelves ~20 budget/regional lines (Sugar 'N Spice spice packets and bagged Chile De Arbol in produce, canned milks and refrigerated bagels in dairy, ReaLemon-class juices in beverages, breaded nuggets/fish sticks filed under meat, Pampa rice and Lil Dutch Maid cookies in the trial-sizes aisle, dried prunes in pantry), and the designed valve for exactly this - the reviewed COMMODITY_DEPT table - holds only 7 entries. The standing set re-fires the signature-deduped alert whenever any product string churns, and a REAL new cross-department hijack would arrive buried in a 20-row list a human must diff from memory. The gate must NOT be loosened at category level (that is the script's own recorded rule); per-commodity reviewed exceptions are the designed fix.

items.subject: Grocery: 34 store(s) dropped from a commodity they carry - 2026-08-05 recurrence (current coverage-gaps.json of 08-05 07:26 carries 51)
evidence: coverage-gaps.json (2026-08-05 07:26, classified_against candidates-2026-08-05): 51 gaps, only 7 actionable. by_reason: BASIS-NULL 30 and BAND-DROPPED 14 (both quiet, engine-explained), CLAIMED-BY 5 and RULE-INVISIBLE 2 (actionable). The alert in check-ad-cycles.ps1 (~line 382) counts gap_count and signatures the FULL set, so 44 permanently-quiet rows (each-unit produce vs weight or cut-tray sizes like "Fresh Lemons, 2 lb Bag" on per-each lemons; band saves like plums vs "NatureWell Orchid & Plum Moisturizing Cream") re-page on every churn.

actionable 1: baby-formula @ Sams Club, CLAIMED-BY oat-milk: "Bubs Goat Milk Infant Formula Powder With Iron, 20 oz., 2 pk." | $57.78 / 40 oz | would be 1.4445/oz. Mechanism: the oat-milk include has no word boundary and matches INSIDE "Goat Milk"; oat-milk sits at array index 147, baby-formula at 295, so first-match-wins blocks the formula from its own commodity. The same bug also pollutes: "Meyenberg Evaporated Vitamin D Goat Milk" (Walmart $4.38 / 12 fl oz) routes to oat-milk today.

actionable 2: frozen-pizza @ Aldi, CLAIMED-BY eggs: "Breakfast Best Sausage Egg Cheese Breakfast Pizza 2pk 112 OZ" | $3.99 | the eggs include (index 6) grabs the name via the word Egg; eggs cannot price it per dozen so it publishes nowhere, and frozen-pizza (index 85) never sees it. The other Aldi pizza rows are quiet BASIS-NULL (single pizzas with oz-only sizes on a per-each commodity).

actionable 3: acorn-squash @ Family Fare, RULE-INVISIBLE: "Acorn/Table Queen Squash" | $1.99 per lb | the include cannot cross the "/Table Queen" infix; no other commodity matches the name (verified by routing sim).

actionable 4-6, loosened-probe artifacts (allowlist, not rule fixes): canned-pineapple @ Family Fare - "Daisy 4% Milkfat With Crushed Pineapples Cottage Cheese 6 Oz" is correctly CLAIMED-BY cottage-cheese; tea-bags @ Sams Club - "Members Mark Extra Fine Whole Green Beans 16 oz. steam bags, 5 ct." matches only the LOOSENED probe (the letters tea inside sTEAm); mangoes @ Walmart - the capture holds only cut trays (quiet BASIS-NULL on a per-each commodity), dried sweetened mango, and the "Floridas Natural Peach Mango 59 oz" juice claimed by peaches (unpriceable fl oz against lb, latent only).

actionable 7: fruit-snacks @ Sams Club, RULE-INVISIBLE: "Members Mark Cheese, Fruit and Nut Snacks, 12 pk." | $9.12 / 12 ct - a Balanced-Breaks-style cheese and fruit and nut tray, genuinely NOT fruit snacks; needs a ruling, not a rule.

bonus wrong-routing found while reading the claimants: canned-green-beans @ Sams Club claims "Members Mark Extra Fine Whole Green Beans 16 oz. steam bags, 5 ct." | $9.67 / 80 oz = 0.1209/oz - FRESH steam-in-bag beans on a CANNED commodity (the name lacks the word fresh so the exclude misses); it loses today to the DelMonte 101 oz canned row at 0.0572/oz but would take the cell at twice the canned price if that row lapsed.

surface_fix.what: alert on ACTIONABLE gaps only: derive the count, the commodity@store list and the dedup signature from the actionable subset; quiet BASIS-NULL/BAND-DROPPED rows stay in coverage-gaps.json for the record but stop paging
surface_fix.exact_change: in the coverage-gap block (~line 382): build the actionable subset of cg.gaps; alert only when it is non-empty; compute cgSig, cgList and the subject count from that subset; keep the Log line reporting both counts, e.g. "51 gap(s), 7 actionable"

items.root_cause: two mechanisms. (a) The ALERT reads gap_count over the full set while the audit itself already separates actionable from engine-explained; 44 of 51 rows are structurally permanent refusals (an each-commodity whose store rows carry only weight or cut-tray sizes can never price - the same class as the reviewed 2026-07-28 breakfast-sandwiches allowlist entry), so the signature churns daily and buries the 7 real rows. (b) Among the 7: an include with a missing word boundary (oat milk matching inside Goat Milk), a lower-index commodity eating a name it can never price (eggs vs a breakfast pizza), an include that cannot express a store slash-naming (Acorn/Table Queen), and three loosened-probe artifacts whose designed answer is a reviewed allowlist entry.

root_fix.what: fix the three routing bugs at the rule level, quiet the three artifacts through the designed allowlist, rule the one true different-product, and add the steam-bags exclude found while reading
root_fix.exact_change: commodities.json: R1 oat-milk include "oat\s*milk" becomes "\boat\s*milk" and "oat\s+beverage" becomes "\boat\s+beverage"; R2 eggs exclude += "\bpizza\b"; R3 canned-green-beans exclude += "steam\s+bags?"; R6 acorn-squash include += "acorn/table\s+queen\s+squash". coverage-gap-allowlist.json: add canned-pineapple|Family Fare (loosened probe hit a cottage cheese the engine already routes correctly), tea-bags|Sams Club (tea inside steam bags; the store's only probe hit is green beans), mangoes|Walmart (capture holds only cut trays, dried mango and a juice - no whole mango; retire the entry when a full Walmart pull lands one). add-known-wrong.ps1: fruit-snacks | Sams Club | "Members Mark Cheese, Fruit and Nut Snacks, 12 pk." (cheese and fruit and nut tray, not fruit snacks).
root_fix.note: the Floridas Natural Peach Mango juice stays routed to peaches deliberately: it can never price (fl oz against a lb commodity) so it can never publish, and excluding it from peaches would only hand it to mangoes (index 101 vs 24) with the same latency; recorded so a future basis change re-opens the question

Re-ran audit-coverage-gaps against the morning build as the freshness line requires (coverage-gaps.json 2026-08-06 06:50, classified_against candidates-2026-08-06): 43 gaps / 8 actionable, not the 51 / 7 the plan measured. items.deviation: THREE deviations, all measured. (1) mangoes @ Walmart: the plan's premise ("the capture holds only cut trays, dried mango and a juice") was falsified - the gap had vanished because a WRONG PRODUCT had filled the cell. comparison-2026-08-06 priced mangoes @ Walmart at $1.385/each from "Aidells Refrigerated Spicy Mango with Jalapeno Smoked Chicken Sausage Links, 12 oz, 4 Count" ($5.54 / 4 links), arrived with the resumed Walmart pull in walmart-regular-2026-08-06.json. mangoes' include is mango(?:es|s)? and no exclude covers sausage. Handled with the designed intake rather than a new regex the reviewer never measured: add-known-wrong ruling mangoes|Walmart, enforced at compare time by known-wrong-lib, which DROPPED the cell on the rebuild. The gap then re-opened exactly as the plan described, and the plan's allowlist entry (rewritten with today's engine-seen evidence and a DELETE-TRIGGER) now covers it. Residual, recorded not fixed: a mango-flavoured sausage at another store would still route to mangoes. (2) TWO new actionable gaps appeared after the plan was measured, both instances of classes the plan already handles, so fixed and noted rather than bounced: watermelon @ Walmart (the only actionable candidate is "Taste Salud Strawberry Watermelon" $9.98/1.27 oz, a powdered drink mix claimed by strawberries; every other /watermelon/ row in the capture is a cut tray or a drink - no whole melon in this bot-walled partial pull) and plastic-wrap @ Walmart (the only candidate is "Hormel ... Uncured Bacon ... 12 oz Plastic Wrapper" $5.97, which the engine already routes CORRECTLY to bacon - a loosened-probe artifact identical in kind to canned-pineapple|Family Fare). Both allowlisted with the engine-seen price_text/size_text and a delete-trigger. Corroboration for the "bot-walled partial capture" reasoning: guards' cell-drops warning lists mangoes @ Walmart (was $0.75), watermelon @ Walmart (was $4.65) and plastic-wrap @ Walmart (was $2.14) as everyday cells present on comparison-2026-08-01 and missing today, i.e. Walmart really does carry all three and this capture simply does not reach them. (3) NEW MECHANISM worth a reviewer's attention, measured: R1 was predicted to make Sam's "gain a candidate at 1.4445/oz, mid-table, crown unchanged". It did not gain a candidate - it REPLACED the Sam's cell. Sam's baby-formula went from "Member's Mark, Advantage Premium, Infant Formula, 48 oz." $0.7704/oz to "Bubs Goat Milk Infant Formula 20 oz., 2 pk." $1.4445/oz, an 87% rise. Mechanism: admitting a name to a commodity can EVICT that store's cheaper existing cell, because Select-FreshestCaptureRows keeps only the rows from the freshest capture that COVERS the commodity - the Member's Mark row is in sams-deals-2026-07-29 and the Bubs row is in sams-deals-2026-08-05, so once baby-formula is covered by the newer capture the older capture's rows are filtered out. Both rows are real and correctly priced, so this is not a wrong cell, but a blast-radius model expressed as "gains a candidate" is structurally blind to it. Kept: the rule fix is right (goat milk is not oat milk, and R1 also removed the Meyenberg goat-milk pollutant from oat-milk's pool). VERIFICATION: post-change audit-coverage-gaps reports gap_count=30, actionable_count=0, exit 0, "no ACTIONABLE gap".
